dct_description_sm: Abstract: This coverage contains boundary lines for the approximately 24,200 Assessor's property parcels.

Purpose: This layer is intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and may be used for basic applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data. This layer will provide a basemap for layers related to real property as well as more advanced user applications such as urban and transportation planning, public policy, public works, or utilities purposes (including defining boundaries, managing assets and facilities, integrating attribute databases with geographic features, spatial analysis, and presentation output.)

Supplemental information: The Engineering Department maintains this data layer using a customized GIS editing application. Lot lines removed when properties are merged are, along with the appropriate label point, deleted. New boundaries are digitized directly from sub-division plans filed with the city by developers or Coordinate Geometry (COGO) data entry is used when available. Control points for the digitizing are property boundary junctions visible on both the parcel coverage and the sub-division plan. While this is not ideal, it mimics the current process and, in the one test performed, produced a better result (based on comparative measurements) than the equivalent manual process.
